verses.1: Children, obey your parents in everything they do. This is indeed what is right.
verses.2: Honor your father and mother, as it is the first commandment in the teachings of God.
verses.3: So that it may be good for you, and so that it may last for a long time on this earth.
verses.4: And your fathers also, do not provoke your children; instead, raise them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
verses.5: O servants, obey those lords who rule over you with fear and trembling, with a pure heart, just as Christ commanded.
verses.6: Not in a way that is arbitrary or artificial, but as slaves of Christ, fulfilling God’s will. From the heart.
verses.7: Working with fairness and honesty, both for the Lord and not for humans.
verses.8: You know that whoever does what is good will receive it from the Lord, whether he be a slave or a free man.
verses.9: And those rulers also do the same things towards them. They fear the threat of punishment. They know that both they and you belong to the Lord in heaven, and there is no way for them to escape His judgment.
verses.10: The rest of you must also exert your strength within the king and in his realm, where his power resides.
verses.11: Put on the armor of God, so that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil.
verses.12: Because it’s not about blood and flesh for us, but about the principles, about the powers, about those who rule over this darkness, about the spiritual forces of evil in the heavens.
verses.13: Therefore, take up the armor of God, so that you may be able to resist the evil one on that day. And by doing this, you will be able to stand firm against all kinds of challenges.
verses.14: So, let us truly protect what belongs to you, and let us wear the armor of justice.
verses.15: and putting their feet into the preparations for the gospel of peace,
verses.16: Taking up the key to the door of faith in everyone, so that all of you may be able to shut off the evil one’s temptations.
verses.17: And hold the head of salvation, as well as the sword of the Spirit. This is the mark of God.
verses.18: Through constant prayer and petition, we pray at all times, in every moment and with every breath. We also pray to Him in every difficult and challenging situation, regarding everything related to the saints.
verses.19: And for me, so that I may be given the word to open my mouth, to know the mystery of the gospel in its fullness.
verses.20: I send this message in hopes that I can find a way to express myself in it, so that I know what I should say.
verses.21: And you also know what I have done. I hope that everything will become clear to you. My beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, Tikhikos.
verses.22: I have sent him to you, so that you may know about us and also ask for your hearts’ desires.
verses.23: Peace among brothers, and love with faith in God the Father and Jesus Christ.
verses.24: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, after all those who love Him, in His death.
